incidents.text: Goal! Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top right corner. Mahmoud Abunada had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:0.
An own goal! Mahmoud Abunada (Qatar) had a great deal of bad luck. He wanted to intercept a dangerous pass, but he hit it in badly and sent it past his goalkeeper.
Goal! Hasan Al Haydos (Qatar) scores after an assist by Edmilson Junior that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:1.
Half-time substitution. Ivan Sunjic is replaced by Benjamin Tahirovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).
The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Arjan Malic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) comes off for Amar Memic.
Julen Lopetegui has made a change at the break. Abdulaziz Hatem has come on in place of Jassem Gaber (Qatar).
Hasan Al Haydos (Qatar) is substituted due to injury. Julen Lopetegui gives a chance to Ahmed Al Ganehi.
That will be all from Nikola Katic who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Dennis Hadzikadunic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).
Sergej Barbarez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ermin Mahmic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) replacing Edin Dzeko.
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Karim Boudiaf trots off the pitch and is replaced by Almoez Ali (Qatar).
What was Ahmed Fathi (Qatar) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
Substitution. Edmilson Junior will be replaced by Ahmed Alaaeldin (Qatar).
Julen Lopetegui prepares a substitution. Ahmed Fathi is replaced by Mohammad Al Mannai (Qatar).
Goal! Ermin Mahmic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:1.
The game has come to an end for Kerim Alajbegovic. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Dzenis Burnic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).
Ermin Mahmic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
